description.content: Send event data directly to the Adobe Experience Platform Edge Network. Supports both interactive (interact) and non-interactive (collect) data collection with authenticated and non-authenticated modes.

Send a single event to the Adobe Experience Platform Edge Network and receive a response with personalization decisions, identity stitching, and other real-time results. This endpoint does not support batch events; use the collect endpoint for multiple events.

query.description: (Required) The ID of the datastream configured in Adobe Experience Platform for data routing and processing.
An optional external request tracing ID. If not provided, the Edge Network generates one automatically.

info.name: Adobe Experience Platform Data Collection API

description.content:
The Data Collection APIs provide endpoints for sending data directly to the Adobe Experience Platform Edge Network. The Edge Network API supports both authenticated and non-authenticated data ingestion, while the Media Edge API enables media tracking data transmission. These APIs allow real-time data collection from web, mobile, and IoT devices.
